g.text: Gold and gray cells appear only in rows 0–2. They form two contiguous blocks …

text.style: font-size: 5.65px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #141718

g.text: … actions can bring them together or change their widths and positions. …

text.style: font-size: 5.65px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #141718

g.text: … left: … If a gray block exists, it shifts left by one column …

text.style: font-size: 5.65px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #141718

g.text: … right: … The column vacated on the left becomes empty unless it is immediately right of a gold block, …

text.style: font-size: 5.65px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #141718

g.text: in which case that column becomes gold (the gold block expands rightwards into it). …

font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2a78d6
